prompt: Render a single complete 1600x1000 polished native Windows desktop app UI mockup for Echo, an English League of Legends recording app. Direction C: MOMENT DESK. Library-first compact dark app inspired by excellent professional media browsers. Very dark graphite #151719 background, slightly lighter side panels, off-white type, crisp mint selection accents, warm coral death markers. Header 70px Echo original abstract play/bookmark emblem at left, 'Library' large, search box 'Search your moments', upper right unobtrusive 'Waiting for League' indicator and Record settings. Slim 150px left sidebar: Library selected, Matches, Settings, bottom simple recorder status. Main upper 660px area split: LEFT 330px width compact vertical clip list, each row a small thumbnail and clear title, date, 00:23 duration, small Kill/Assist/Death tag; selected 'River skirmish'. RIGHT very large 16:9 paused illustrative League gameplay player with rounded edges, underneath selected clip title, timestamp, playback controls and scrub slider. Bottom main area a precise 140px-high trimming workbench with filmstrip frames, mint trim handles and timeline marks labeled Kill / Assist, Start 00:12 and End 00:35 fields and one Export clip button. Clear thin dividers and typography, minimal app chrome. Show six clip rows but no fake performance metrics, no graphs, no dashboards, no gauges. No gradients, no purple, no glass, no glow, no laptop mockup. Highly readable, credible and beautiful, video content is dominant. All clip contents and dates illustrative. Layout materially different from a card grid: professional list and integrated player.
description: Illustrative design mockup, not an application screenshot.
